title: Gabriela Mistral and Pablo Neruda: two Chilean Nobel poets
goal: Talk about the two Chilean Nobel poets, Gabriela Mistral and Pablo Neruda, showing your attitude with stance adverbs.
grammar: focus and stance adverbs like precisamente and francamente

items: I can show my attitude to a fact about the poets with stance adverbs such as *en realidad*, *en rigor* and *lamentablemente*.
I can say when and where each poet was born and when each received the Nobel Prize.
I can name the main words for poet, poem, prize and poetry in Spanish.
